bullets.text: On-Device Identity Checks - **TruSources** showcases its innovative identity-verification tech at **TechCrunch Disrupt 2025**.
Raleigh One E-Bike Review - The **Raleigh One** offers a simpler, more serviceable design, priced at £2,399.
Pixel Call Recording Returns - **Google** is testing full call recording features on **Pixel** devices in the UK.
AirPods Pro 3 Review - Music producer **Lodewijk Vos** praises the improved sound quality of the **AirPods Pro 3**.
iOS 26 Liquid Glass Apps - Over 30 apps now feature the new **Liquid Glass** design in **iOS 26**.
iPhone Footage in Baseball - **Apple** uses **iPhone 17 Pro** cameras for live footage in **Friday Night Baseball**.
Wallet App Improvements - **iOS 26** enhances the **Apple Wallet** app with better order tracking features.
Google Home App Redesign - The **Google Home** app gets a major redesign with new features rolling out for iPhone.
Humanoid Robot Bubble - Renowned roboticist **Rodney Brooks** warns that the humanoid robot investment bubble is unsustainable.
AI Startup Ad Campaign - **Friend**, an AI startup, spends over $1M on subway ads in NYC.
